mentions.name: Beacio
mentions.description: A Safari extension that brings Web Bluetooth support to iOS, letting web pages in Safari communicate with Bluetooth devices. The author states it already works better than any third-party browser available on the App Store for this purpose.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Web bluetooth for ios (via safari extension). It's already way better than any 3rd party browser available in appstore.

https://beacio.com
mentions.author: wklm
